goals: Keep eligible normally non-stackable item counts intact across Minecraft 26.2 client container and strict item-template reconstruction paths.
Align the client with Stacks Are Stacks' own effective holder maximums while preserving its configuration, eligibility, exclusions, damageable-item handling, and server authority.
Restore visible counts in ordinary containers and visible entries in the Easy Shulker Boxes preview without changing vanilla-stackable controls.
scope: Maintain the client-only Fabric initializer and string-targeted Mixin invoker from Canary 1, exact-pinned to Stacks Are Stacks 2.1.2-1.26.2.
Retain the focused upstream-bytecode, vanilla-rendering-path, and stale-versus-aligned-client contract tests for the two demonstrated failures.
Retain the exact unaccepted Canary 1 binary and its implementation and retention provenance while its physically verified Slot B deployment is tested independently.

exclusions: Replacing or redistributing Stacks Are Stacks, copying its implementation, or changing its stack eligibility, configured maximums, exclusions, ConsumableFix behavior, or server authority.
Mixing into ItemStack, SimpleContainer, menus, slots, container screens, item-count renderers, Easy Shulker Boxes, or Item Interactions, and any unrelated inventory or container behavior.
Treating Easy Shulker Boxes 26.2.3 or its embedded Item Interactions 26.2.2 consumer path as a declared runtime dependency of this add-on.

Rebuilding or substituting Canary 1, changing its source or the upstream Stacks Are Stacks configuration, promoting it before runtime testing, adding CSR-specific compatibility behavior, claiming CSR/Stacks Are Stacks compatibility, launching Minecraft during deployment, or accessing the protected 26.1.2 gameplay profile.
